rules.title: robots.txt welcomes each AI crawler by name (User-agent + Allow)
no robots.txt stanza blocks by accident (Disallow without Allow)
robots.txt Sitemap: line points at the real sitemap URL
llms.txt exists in the expected format (# title, > blurb, ## sections, - [title](abs url): desc)
llms.txt drift: every link resolves on disk and every blog series is represented
every post carries one BlogPosting JSON-LD block with the required fields
every ld+json block sitewide parses and carries the required fields for its @type
post dates agree: JSON-LD datePublished == article:published_time == <time datetime>
root page carries the WebSite + Person entity graph (and no SearchAction)
no orphan itemprop outside an itemscope
titles unique sitewide (FAIL); descriptions unique (WARN)
length bands (advisory, char-based/Thai-safe): title 20-60, description 70-160
post image alts mirror og:title (og:image:alt and twitter:image:alt)
exactly one <h1> per page
no skipped heading level (h2 -> h4) within a post, per language track
every internal href/src resolves on disk (extensionless and directory fallbacks included)
no orphan pages (zero incoming internal links)
no http:// resource or internal link (mixed content / insecure origin)
every declares width and height (CLS)
feed rel=alternate link on the home page and every section index
sitemap lastmod is not older than the file's last git commit (INFO, not WARN, for dirty files)
standing report-only items (no deduction)
